passages.title: 厨房里的闹剧
en: Their core {{proposition}} was straightforward: serve complex molecular gastronomy out of a converted food truck.
But the chef's insistence on using tweezers for every garnish soon became their most {{blatant}} bottleneck.
Customers found the menu {{bewildering}}, filled with {{pretentious}} descriptions of foams and edible dirt.
By the second week, the line down the street had completely vanished.
They failed to secure any real {{foothold}} in the neighborhood, and online reviews were turning increasingly hostile.
Several diners made {{vehement}} complaints about discovering hair in their food, exposing the {{unsavory}} reality behind the shiny exterior.
Rather than trying to {{overturn}} this negative public opinion, the initial investors decided to {{pull-the-plug|pull the plug}} entirely.
The truck was sold the very next morning, leaving the whole experiment as nothing but a minor {{footnote}} in the local culinary history.
zh: 他们的核心方案很直白：在改装的餐车里卖复杂的分子料理。
然而主厨非要用镊子摆盘，这很快成了他们最明显的效率瓶颈。
顾客们对菜单感到一头雾水，上面充斥着对泡沫和可食用泥土故作高深的描述。
到了第二周，街上排队的人就彻底不见了。
他们始终没能在这个街区站稳脚跟，网上的评价也一天比一天刻薄。
几位食客强烈投诉说菜里吃出了头发，暴露出光鲜外表下令人反感的卫生状况。
最初的投资人没有试图去扭转这种负面的公众印象，而是决定直接彻底撤资止损。
那辆餐车第二天一早就被卖掉了，这场实验仅仅成了当地餐饮史上的一段小插曲。

passages.title: 沙漠里的发掘争议
en: The expedition leader claimed he had found the lost tomb, presenting evidence that seemed fairly {{plausible}} at first glance.
He easily persuaded several {{gullible}} sponsors to finance the dig, even though his theories completely contradicted all {{canonical}} historical records.
Upon arriving at the site, the team spent their first week merely collecting surface pottery shards as obvious {{low-hanging-fruit|low-hanging fruit}}.
But as weeks passed, the deeper trenches revealed absolutely nothing but barren rock.
When a visiting inspector pointed this out, it provoked an incredibly {{uncalled-for}} and screaming outburst from the frustrated leader.
This erratic behavior began to rapidly {{alienate}} his most loyal researchers, who quietly started packing their bags.
By the time the most {{eminent}} scholar in the field arrived to evaluate the situation, the camp was nearly abandoned.
The ensuing scandal triggered a catastrophic {{race-to-the-bottom|race to the bottom}} for government grants among rival archaeological institutes.
Beneath his intellectual {{veneer}}, the leader was merely a fraud whose actions would ultimately {{inflict}} lasting damage on the field.
zh: 探险队长声称自己找到了那座失落的陵墓，并出示了乍看之下颇为可信的证据。
他轻而易举地说服了几位耳根软的赞助商为发掘提供资金，尽管他的理论与所有权威史料完全相悖。
抵达现场后，团队第一周只是在收集地表的陶片，尽捡些唾手可得的便宜。
但随着几周过去，挖得更深的探沟里除了贫瘠的岩石外一无所获。
一位来访的视察员当面点破了这一点，换来的是队长一通极其过分、毫无必要的咆哮。
这种阴晴不定的做派很快就把最忠心的研究员一个个推远，他们默不作声地收拾起了行李。
等到业内最杰出的学者赶来评估情况时，营地几乎已经空无一人。
随之而来的丑闻在相互竞争的考古机构之间引发了一场争夺政府拨款的灾难性逐底竞争。
褪去知识分子的伪装，这位队长不过是个骗子，其所作所为最终会对整个行业造成持久的损害。

passages.title: 极地风暴中的争执
en: The research station's heating system was incredibly {{primitive}}, barely keeping the indoor temperature above freezing during the long winter.
Whenever the generator coughed and died, the junior technicians had to {{bear-the-brunt|bear the brunt}} of the manual restart process outside in the blizzard.
Their new commander developed an unhealthy {{fixation}} on fuel consumption, checking the dials every half hour.
He instituted a set of {{regressive}} rationing rules that penalized the field workers who needed warmth the most.
They tried to explain the true {{criticality}} of staying warm, but his {{uncompromising}} stance shut down all discussion.
One afternoon, a biologist joked about his terrible management style in the mess hall.
This minor slight sparked a deeply {{vindictive}} reaction, and he forced her to wear that {{hideous}} neon-orange survival suit indoors as punishment.
Nobody could gather enough evidence to officially {{substantiate}} their complaints to headquarters before the satellite uplink finally went down.
By then, the entire crew shared a strong {{aversion}} to the commander, actively avoiding the common area whenever possible.
zh: 考察站的供暖系统极其简陋，在漫长的冬季里勉强维持室内温度在冰点以上。
每当发电机发出几声异响后罢工，初级技术员们就不得不首当其冲，在暴风雪中去手动重启它。
他们的新站长对燃料消耗产生了一种病态的执念，每半个小时就要去查看一次仪表盘。
他制定了一套倒退的配给规定，使得最需要取暖的野外工作人员反而受到了惩罚。
他们试图讲清楚保暖这件事到底有多性命攸关，可他寸步不让的态度让所有讨论都戛然而止。
一天下午，一位生物学家在食堂里拿他糟糕的管理风格开了句玩笑。
这点小小的冒犯换来了他极其记仇的报复：作为惩罚，他逼那位生物学家在室内也得套着那件丑得刺眼的荧光橙救生服。
在卫星线路彻底中断之前，谁也无法收集到足够的证据来向总部正式证实他们的投诉。
到那时，全体人员都对站长产生了强烈的反感，尽可能地避开公共休息区。

passages.title: 深海密闭舱的暗流
en: The veteran deep-sea pilot was initially quite {{agreeable}} during the shallow test dives near the sunny coastline.
But as they descended deeper into the dark ocean, his cheerful demeanor completely vanished.
He ordered the scientists to dump their backup oxygen tanks, dismissing them as entirely {{superfluous}} weight.
One researcher's dedication to safety was {{commendable}}, yet the captain ignored her warnings with a truly {{callous}} wave of his hand.
The atmosphere in the cramped cabin grew toxic, and widespread {{discontent}} soon replaced the initial excitement.
Someone anonymously typed a highly {{defamatory}} entry into the shared logbook, accusing the pilot of being dangerously incompetent.
When the sonar suddenly failed shortly after, everyone stared at the blank screen in absolute {{bewilderment}}.
Instead of surfacing immediately to fix the issue, the stubborn captain decided to {{kick-the-can-down-the-road|kick the can down the road}} and keep diving blind.
This reckless move abruptly ended their brief {{interlude}} of peace, forcing two engineers to physically {{subdue}} him and trigger the emergency ascent.
zh: 在阳光明媚的海岸线附近进行浅水试潜时，这位资深深海驾驶员起初相当和蔼可亲。
但随着他们潜入更深的黑暗海洋，他那愉快的举止消失得无影无踪。
他命令科学家们丢掉备用氧气罐，不以为然地称其为完全多余的重量。
一位研究员对安全的较真本来值得称道，船长却冷漠无情地一挥手，把她的警告挡了回去。
狭窄船舱里的气氛变得令人窒息，普遍的不满情绪很快取代了最初的兴奋。
有人在共享日志中匿名敲下了一条极具诽谤性的记录，指控这名驾驶员极度不称职。
不久后声纳突然失灵，所有人都盯着那块空白的屏幕，一脸茫然不知所措。
固执的船长没有立即浮出水面去解决问题，而是决定把难题往后推，继续盲目下潜。
这个鲁莽的决定生生掐断了他们那段短暂的平静间隙，逼得两名工程师动手把他制服，触发了紧急上浮。

passages.title: 守塔人的深夜电台
en: The new lighthouse keeper was unusually {{sociable}} for someone who had deliberately chosen to live on an isolated rock.
Every night, he hosted a pirate radio show using his {{inconspicuous}} antenna hidden behind the main lamp room.
His core audience consisted of lonely sailors who were highly {{susceptible}} to the soothing stories he told over the crackling waves.
The routine broadcast quickly became the shared highlight of the long, dark winter.
Over time, his voice gained massive {{prominence}} among the entire coastal {{populace}}.
The keeper spoke naturally and warmly, treating every listener as a friend without any intellectual {{pretension}}.
However, maritime authorities were naturally {{averse}} to such unregulated channels, arguing that he might {{conflate}} dangerous myths with real meteorology.
They finally tracked him down using a barely {{perceptible}} mechanical hum buried in the background of his audio signal.
Shutting down the beloved station did not {{move-the-needle|move the needle}} on regional accident rates, but it certainly left the dark waters feeling much emptier.
zh: 对于一个有意选择住在与世隔绝的礁石上的人来说，这位新任守塔人异乎寻常地好交际。
每天夜里，他都会用隐藏在主灯室后面的不显眼的天线，主持一档海盗电台节目。
他的铁杆听众是一群孤独的水手：电波噼啪作响，他讲的那些抚慰人心的故事，他们最容易被打动。
这档常规广播很快成了漫长而黑暗的冬季里大家共同的期盼。
久而久之，他的声音在整个沿海民众中获得了巨大的知名度。
这位守塔人说话自然而温暖，把每位听众都当成朋友，完全没有任何知识分子式的矫饰。
然而，海事当局自然对这种不受监管的频道感到反感，理由是他可能会把危险的神话和真正的气象学混为一谈。
他的音频信号底下埋着一丝几乎察觉不到的机械嗡鸣，当局最终就是循着这个找到了他。
关停这座备受喜爱的电台，对区域事故率没起到任何实质作用，只是让黑暗的海面显得更空荡了。

passages.title: 种子库的紧急干预
en: The town council argued that upgrading the seed vault's security was an entirely {{unwarranted}} expense during the economic downturn.
Their fatal inaction rested on the flawed {{premise}} that the invading pests would simply freeze when winter arrived.
Meanwhile, those {{voracious}} insects were actively devastating the surrounding farmlands at a terrifying pace.
The head botanist meticulously took {{copious}} notes on the destruction, realizing that waiting for frost was pure administrative {{myopia}}.
She knew her team had to act decisively before the regional harvest was lost forever.
To effectively {{preempt}} this looming agricultural disaster, she ordered highly toxic chemical sprays around the reinforced entrance.
This aggressive {{preemptive}} strike was executed strictly {{pursuant}} to a forgotten ecological protocol from a decade ago.
Local farming families felt a profound sense of {{alienation}} from their elected politicians who had completely ignored the threat.
In the end, the embarrassed committee had no choice but to quietly {{rubber-stamp}} the botanist's unauthorized defensive measures.
zh: 镇议会辩称，经济下行的当口给种子库升级安保，是一笔完全没有道理的开支。
他们致命的不作为建立在一个错误的前提上，即只要冬天一到，入侵的害虫就会直接冻死。
与此同时，那些贪婪的昆虫正以惊人的速度肆意破坏着周围的农田。
首席植物学家一丝不苟地记下了大量关于破坏情况的笔记，她意识到指望霜冻纯粹是行政短视。
她深知自己的团队必须在地区庄稼彻底绝收之前果断采取行动。
为了赶在这场迫在眉睫的农业灾难落地之前先下手，她下令在加固过的入口一圈喷洒剧毒药剂。
这次激进的先发制人的行动，严格依照的是十年前一份早被遗忘的生态条例。
当地务农家庭对完全无视威胁的民选政客产生了一种深深的疏离感。
最后，尴尬的委员会别无选择，只能悄悄走个过场，追认了植物学家这套未经授权的防御措施。

passages.title: 钟表匠行会的暗算
en: The veteran watchmakers shared a deep {{subconscious}} distrust of anyone using computerized measuring tools in their traditional workshop.
They stubbornly believed in this {{trickle-down}} theory of learning, wrongly assuming apprentices would absorb skills simply by sweeping the wooden floors.
This highly {{insular}} community rarely admitted outsiders, tightly guarding their historical family secrets from the rest of the town.
However, one particularly {{industrious}} young woman spent her isolated nights quietly rebuilding delicate chronographs with microscopic precision.
Jealous older rivals soon maliciously spread {{slanderous}} rumors, claiming she was secretly outsourcing the complex gear cutting to a factory.
Instead of arguing, she introduced strict {{sterilization}} procedures to protect her delicate work, answering their vicious accusations with genuine {{modesty}}.
But the social damage was already done, and the once-quiet workshop atmosphere became permanently toxic.
Their fierce mutual {{antipathy}} finally boiled over publicly during the highly anticipated annual spring exhibition.
The frantic guild master tried to {{appease}} both factions with a fragile compromise, which would sadly {{foreshadow}} the eventual splitting of the centuries-old organization.
zh: 对于任何在传统工坊里动用电脑测量工具的人，几位资深钟表匠都怀着一种深埋在潜意识里的不信任。
他们固执地相信这种涓滴式的学习理论，错误地认为学徒们只要扫扫木地板就能吸收技能。
这个高度封闭的圈子极少接纳外人，严密地向镇上其他人保守着他们的历史家族秘密。
偏偏有一位格外勤奋的年轻女子，把一个个独处的夜晚都花在了重修精密计时码表上，精度细到要在显微镜下才看得出来。
几个心生嫉妒的老前辈很快恶意散布起诽谤性的谣言，说她私底下把复杂的齿轮切削活儿外包给了工厂。
她没有争辩，而是立了一套严格的灭菌流程来护住自己那些精细的活计，只以一份实实在在的谦逊回应那些恶毒的指控。
但人情上的裂痕已经落下了，曾经安静的工坊从此变得令人窒息。
他们之间强烈的相互反感最终在备受期待的年度春季展览期间公开爆发了。
手忙脚乱的行会会长想用一个脆弱的折中方案安抚两派，而这恰恰预示了这个几百年的组织终将一分为二。

passages.title: 破解死语的执念
en: There remained one highly {{conspicuous}} physical gap in the clay tablet right where the central text had been chipped away.
A deeply {{tenacious}} linguist spent twelve exhausting years relentlessly comparing those faded symbols against forgotten desert dialects.
Her academic colleagues remained remarkably {{nonchalant}} about the missing fragment, lazily assuming it was just another boring tax receipt.
She completely ignored their skepticism.
Even after delivering a rather {{rambling}} presentation that bored the symposium audience, she continued her research despite the university's {{capricious}} funding cuts.
Her luck changed when she discovered another vast hidden {{corpus}} of untouched tablets buried beneath a ruined temple.
The absolute {{crux}} of her new phonetic theory depended entirely on proving that a tiny bird symbol represented a continuous vowel sound.
When the final puzzle piece finally fell into place, she joyfully abandoned all professional {{decorum}} to shout in pure triumph.

The deciphered poem seemed to perfectly {{embody}} the tragic history of a drought-stricken civilization, taking her team weeks to safely {{extricate}} the remaining fragile documents from the hardened mud.
zh: 泥板正中的文字被磕掉了一块，留下一处格外扎眼的空缺。
一位极其顽强的语言学家为此熬了十二年，把那些褪色的符号一个个比对早已失传的沙漠方言。
同行们对那块缺失的残片却出奇地满不在乎，想当然地认为那不过又是一张无聊的税单。
她完全无视了他们的质疑。
她在研讨会上做过一场相当不着边际的报告，把听众讲得昏昏欲睡；即便如此，即便校方的经费说砍就砍、毫无定准，她也没有停下。
转机出现在一座废弃神庙底下：她在那里挖到了另一批数量庞大、从未有人动过的泥板语料。
她那套新语音理论的关键所在，全押在一件事上——证明那个小小的鸟形符号代表的是一个连续的元音。
当最后一块拼图终于归位，她把学者的体面全抛到了脑后，纯粹出于胜利的喜悦大喊了一声。
那首被破译的诗，仿佛把一个被旱灾拖垮的文明的悲惨历史整个装了进去；而余下那些脆弱的文书，她的团队又花了好几周才从板结的泥里安全起取出来。

passages.title: 货轮上的风暴夜
en: The captain stared at the radar screen, watching the squall line approach the freighter.
To {{assuage}} the crew's mounting panic, he ordered the first mate to secure the loose containers.
His {{contentious}} decision to sail straight through the gale was met with several {{facetious}} remarks from the chief engineer.
The engineer felt it was {{presumptuous}} to ignore the safety warnings issued by the maritime authority.
He threatened to {{denounce}} the captain once they reached port, dismissing the leadership's brave talk as empty {{rhetoric}}.
That {{reclusive}} deckhand, who rarely spoke to anyone during the voyage, stepped forward and grabbed the ropes.
With {{deft}} movements, he navigated the {{intricacy|intricacies}} of the rigging machinery despite the pitching vessel.
Minutes later, the captain {{promulgate|promulgated}} an emergency protocol, forcing everyone to put on life jackets.
zh: 船长盯着雷达屏幕，注视着飑线逼近货轮。
为了缓和船员们日益加剧的恐慌，他命令大副固定那些松动的集装箱。
然而，他径直穿过大风的这个有争议的决定，却引来了轮机长几句油腔滑调的玩笑。
轮机长认为，无视海事局发出的安全警告是非常自以为是的。
他甚至威胁说一到港口就要公开揭发船长，把领导层的豪言壮语斥为空话。
那个在航行中极少与人交谈的孤僻水手，走上前抓住了绳索。
尽管船只剧烈颠簸，他还是凭借灵巧的动作，处理了索具机械那复杂的细节。
几分钟后，船长颁布了一项紧急协议，强制所有人穿上救生衣。

passages.title: 标本馆里的秘密
en: The old botanist locked the heavy oak doors of the archive room.
He refused to {{capitulate}} to the museum board, who viewed the dried plant collections as {{extraneous}} items taking up valuable space.
Their argument earlier that afternoon had turned {{belligerent}}, with voices echoing through the silent halls.
To the scholar, the {{intrinsic}} value of these rare flora samples was impossible to replace with {{sumptuous}} modern displays.
One specific fern leaf from 1890 could {{corroborate}} his theory about historic climate shifts.
The newly appointed director wanted to {{depose}} him from his position as head curator.
Management considered his traditional preservation methods nothing but {{retrograde}} steps for the institution.
Stress had recently caused him to {{relapse}} into a nervous condition, mirroring the {{dystrophy}} that weakened his muscles years ago.
zh: 老植物学家锁上了档案室厚重的橡木门。
他拒绝向博物馆董事会妥协，因为他们把这些风干的植物收藏视为占用宝贵空间的多余物品。
他们那天下午早些时候的争吵变得火药味十足，声音在寂静的走廊里回荡。
对这位学者来说，这些罕见植物标本的内在价值，是无法用奢华的现代展览来替代的。
一片来自1890年的特定蕨类叶片，可以证实他关于历史气候变化的理论。
新上任的馆长想罢黜他首席研究员的职位。
管理层认为他传统的保存方法对机构而言完全是倒退的举措。
压力最近导致他旧病复发陷入紧张状态，情况类似于多年前使他肌肉衰弱的萎缩症。

passages.title: 攀岩队的最后尝试
en: The wind howled against the nylon tent pitched on the narrow ledge.
The expedition leader, a young {{aspirant}} to the world record, watched his team grow increasingly {{fractious}}.
Fatigue had made their attitudes toxic, almost like some {{malignant}} disease spreading through the camp.
One climber tried to {{repudiate}} the agreed-upon route, finding it {{contemptible}} that they were taking such insane risks.
He drafted a written statement, almost like a legal {{deposition}}, to document his formal objection.
Since childhood, his severe {{dyslexia}} meant he hated writing, but this situation demanded a clear record.
The leader stepped out to {{refute}} the man's claims, arguing that the summit was still within reach.
Looking up at that {{ravishing}} alpenglow on the peak, neither man wanted to {{succumb}} to the mountain's harsh conditions.
zh: 狂风呼啸着吹打着搭在狭窄岩架上的尼龙帐篷。
探险队队长是个渴望打破世界纪录的年轻人，他看着自己的队伍变得越来越难以驾驭。
疲惫把他们的脾气一个个磨坏了，那股戾气像某种恶性病一样，在营地里一顶帐篷一顶帐篷地传。
一名攀岩者试图全盘否定之前商定的路线，觉得他们冒如此疯狂的风险实在可鄙。
他草拟了一份书面声明，简直像是一份法律证词，用来记录他的正式反对意见。
从童年起，他严重的阅读障碍就意味着他讨厌写字，但现在的情况需要一份清晰的记录。
队长走出去反驳了那个人的说法，争辩说顶峰依然触手可及。
抬头看着山顶上那迷人的高山余辉，两个男人都不想屈服于这座山恶劣的条件。

passages.title: 夜校里的沉默
en: The fluorescent lights buzzed overhead as adults squeezed into the tiny wooden desks.
The teacher reviewed that {{eclectic}} mix of essays, feeling deep {{ambivalence}} about her students' progress.
One paper contained a highly {{dubious}} claim about ancient history that lacked any factual basis.
The author had managed to {{beguile}} his classmates into believing a story about the most {{depraved}} of the medieval kings.
She worried this misinformation would {{metastasize}} throughout the classroom if left unchecked.
It was easy to let such errors pass to avoid making anyone feel {{dishearten|disheartened}}.
However, professional {{propriety}} dictated that she correct the historical record immediately.
Her {{judicious}} choice of words let her stay {{resolute}} about the correction without crushing the student's enthusiasm.
zh: 头顶的荧光灯嗡嗡作响，成年人们挤在狭小的木制课桌前。
老师批阅着那一批风格兼收并蓄的散文，对学生们的进步感到深深的矛盾心理。
其中一篇论文包含了一个关于古代历史的极其可疑的观点，缺乏任何事实依据。
作者硬是把同学们哄住了，让他们信了一个关于中世纪最堕落的那位国王的故事。
她担心如果置之不理，这种错误信息会在整个教室里扩散开来。
为了避免让任何人感到灰心，人们很容易对这样的错误一笑而过。
然而，出于职业的规矩，她必须立即纠正这个历史事实。
她措辞明智，既在这处纠正上寸步不让，又没把学生的热情打下去。

passages.title: 跨州大巴上的插曲
en: The air conditioning on the coach broke down, leaving everyone trapped in that {{sweltering}} heat for hours.
An older passenger began to {{grumble}} about the delay, condemning management's {{egregious}} negligence.
She managed to pry open a tiny window at the back.
The slight breeze did little to {{alleviate}} the stuffy cabin, while the root cause of the mechanical failure continued to {{elude}} our driver.
Beside me sat the {{pious}} one of the pair, reading his pocket Bible and ignoring the rising tension around him.
The rest of the travelers were {{riven}} by a bitter argument over whether to force a highway stop.
Some insisted that calling a rescue vehicle now would be pure {{wastefulness}} of time.
Others criticized the headquarters' {{insularity}}, claiming executives never rode their own buses.
The shouting match ended when we pulled into a dusty service station.
A local mechanic twisted some {{malleable}} copper wire into a temporary fuse, and the engine roared to life.
zh: 长途大巴上的空调坏了，让所有人都被困在那酷热难耐的高温中长达数小时。
一位年长的乘客开始抱怨延误，谴责管理层极其恶劣的疏忽。
她费力地在后排推开了一扇小窗户。
那点微风几乎无法缓解闷热的车厢，而机械故障的根本原因依然令我们的司机毫无头绪。
坐在我旁边的是两人里虔诚的那一个，他读着随身的袖珍圣经，对周围不断升级的紧张气氛毫不理会。
其余的旅客因为是否要强行在高速公路上停车而陷入了分裂。
有些人坚持认为，现在叫救援车完全是浪费时间。
另一些人则批评总部的思想闭塞，声称高管们从来不坐自家的大巴。
这场争吵直到我们驶入一个满是灰尘的服务站才结束。
一名当地修理工把一根可塑的铜丝拧成了一个临时保险丝，发动机又轰鸣了起来。

passages.title: 庄园清算日
en: The attorney read that {{ominous}} letter aloud to the gathered relatives.
It outlined the sheer {{enormity}} of the deceased uncle's debts, silencing the room.
Decades of reckless gambling had left the family with debts of {{ruinous}} size.
The oldest brother voiced his {{grievance}}, finding the idea of selling the family home completely {{abhorrent}}.
The estate's ledgers did not {{cohere}} with the lavish lifestyle the old man had maintained.
To make sense of the chaos, an accountant had to {{disaggregate}} years of tangled bank statements.
They realized the property was {{mire|mired}} in obscure legal disputes.
The tension in the dusty library was thick enough to cut with a knife.
Their only {{solace}} was finding a registered {{purebred}} stallion forgotten in the back stables.
Auctioning the magnificent creature off might be their only way to avoid bankruptcy.
zh: 律师向聚集在一起的亲属们大声宣读了那封不祥的信件。
信里概述了已故叔叔所欠债务的极端严重性，让整个房间陷入了死寂。
几十年不管不顾地赌下来，给这家人留下了一笔足以倾家荡产的债务。
大哥表达了他的不满，他觉得卖掉祖宅这个想法令人憎恶。
庄园的账本与老爷子生前维持的奢华生活方式在逻辑上不连贯。
为了理清这一团乱麻，会计师不得不把多年来错综复杂的银行流水拆分开来进行分析。
他们意识到，这处房产已经陷入了隐晦的法律纠纷泥沼中。
满是灰尘的图书室里，紧张的气氛凝重得仿佛能用刀切开。
他们唯一的慰藉，就是在后马厩里找到了一匹被遗忘的有登记记录的纯种公马。
把这匹神气的动物拍卖掉，可能是他们避免破产的唯一出路。

passages.title: 老印刷厂的火灾
en: The cheap solvent they used was a known {{precursor}} to flammable gases.
Leaving it near the furnace was a careless decision that would {{implicate}} the floor manager.
A stray spark from that {{angular}} metal gear ignited the fumes, and the blast managed to {{engender}} absolute panic.
Workers scrambled toward the emergency exits as alarms blared.
Within minutes, the blaze threatened the total {{obliteration}} of the century-old facility.
Firefighters dragged a breathless operator outside, trying to {{resuscitate}} him before the {{dilapidated}} roof caved in.
Burning debris rained down on the asphalt parking lot.
That {{acrid}} cloud of toxic smoke drifted toward the residential neighborhood.
The factory owner issued {{profuse}} apologies to the community the next morning.
Yet the charred ruins stood there, casting a truly {{forbidding}} shadow over the edge of town.
zh: 他们使用的廉价溶剂是一种已知会生成易燃气体的前体。
把它留在熔炉附近是个粗心的决定，这牵连了车间主任。
从那个带棱角的金属齿轮上溅出的一点火花点燃了气体，爆炸引发了绝对的恐慌。
警报声大作，工人们争先恐后地向紧急出口逃生。
短短几分钟内，大火就威胁要将这座拥有百年历史的工厂彻底摧毁。
消防员把一名失去呼吸的操作工拖到室外，在破旧的屋顶坍塌前试图让他苏醒。
燃烧的碎片像雨点般落在了柏油停车场上。
那团刺鼻的有毒黑烟朝着住宅区飘去。
工厂老板第二天早上向社区表达了大量的歉意。
然而，那些烧焦的废墟依然矗立在那里，在小镇边缘投下了一道真正令人生畏的阴影。

passages.title: 街头乐队的解散
en: The label gave the musicians zero {{leeway}} when drafting the grueling summer tour schedule.
Their aggressive manager warned that financial ruin was {{imminent}}, yet the drummer remained {{apathetic}}.
He rarely bothered to show up for afternoon soundchecks.
Meanwhile, the lead singer pitched his new concept album with exhausting {{fervor}}, having developed some {{morbid}} fascination with tragic historical figures.
He drafted a ten-minute rock opera about the last {{sentient}} execution machine on earth.
The rest of the band could not stand the creative direction.
Frustrated by the chaos, the bassist chose to {{abrogate}} his verbal contract with the group.
He realized the manager's confusing royalty statements were designed to {{swindle}} everyone out of merchandise profits.
To avoid a messy court battle, the lawyers had to {{delineate}} who owned the rights to which songs.
Ultimately, the tight-knit trio dissolved into this {{heterogeneous}} mix of bitter solo artists.
zh: 厂牌在安排严酷的夏季巡演日程时，没有给音乐人们留任何回旋余地。
他们激进的经纪人警告说财务破产即将发生，但鼓手依然冷漠不关心。
他现在甚至懒得在下午的试音环节露面了。
与此同时，主唱带着令人疲惫的狂热推销他的新概念专辑，他对悲剧历史人物产生了一种病态的迷恋。
他写了一部十分钟的摇滚歌剧，讲地球上最后一台有意识的行刑机器。
乐队的其他成员根本无法忍受这种创作方向。
贝斯手对这种混乱感到沮丧，决定废除他与乐队的口头协议。
他意识到经纪人那些令人困惑的版税报表，就是为了骗取大家的周边商品利润而设计的。
为了避免陷入混乱的法庭诉讼，律师们不得不精确界定谁拥有哪些歌曲的版权。
最终，这个曾经关系紧密的三人组，解散成了各种单飞艺人组成的异质混合体。

passages.title: 兽医站的日常
en: The new clinic director unveiled his {{grandiose}} plans for a luxury pet spa at the {{impromptu}} staff meeting he had called that morning.
In reality, our current workplace was that {{austere}} cinderblock building with peeling paint.
We barely had enough space to store the incoming dog food.
It was always that common {{fallacy}} among clients that veterinary medicine was a highly lucrative business.
The technicians would often {{grouse}} about the broken X-ray machine.
Yesterday, a local charity had to {{intercede}} and pay the bills for a stray cat suffering from abnormal fluid {{secretion|secretions}}.
The poor animal needed immediate surgery to survive the night.
Our senior doctor operated on some {{amorphous}} mass near its stomach.
Later, he took time to {{officiate}} a tiny backyard burial for a hamster that didn't make it.
Despite the exhausting shifts, most of us remained {{sanguine}} about saving the next patient.
zh: 新来的诊所主任在他当天上午临时召集的员工会上，抛出了他那套建豪华宠物水疗馆的浮夸计划。
而现实中，我们目前的工作场所只是一栋油漆剥落的简朴煤渣砖楼。
我们几乎连存放新进狗粮的空间都没有。
客户们一直有个普遍的谬误，认为兽医是一门利润丰厚的生意。
技师们经常抱怨那台坏掉的X光机。
昨天，一家当地慈善机构不得不出面斡旋，替一只饱受异常体液分泌折磨的流浪猫支付了账单。
那只可怜的小动物需要立即手术才能熬过夜晚。
我们的资深兽医给它做了手术，取出胃部附近一个形状不规则的肿块。
后来，他抽时间为一只没救过来的仓鼠主持了一个小型的后院葬礼。
尽管轮班令人精疲力竭，但大多数人对拯救下一个病患依然保持着乐观。

passages.title: 货运仓库的雨夜
en: The night shift manager felt deeply {{apprehensive}} about the approaching storm.
A sudden power outage plunged the entire loading dock into darkness.
This threatened to {{exacerbate}} the chaos, as its {{ostensible}} cause remained unknown.
Small companies rarely enjoy any {{level-playing-field}} against major logistics firms.
That lack of fairness did not, however, {{extenuate}} the supervisor's continuous {{ineptitude}}.
He had failed to secure the heavy crates properly.
Any further delays would only {{antagonize}} the truck drivers waiting outside.
One impatient driver made some {{gratuitous}} comment about human operators being inherently {{fallible}}.
Upgrading the safety system was clearly no longer considered {{elective}}.
zh: 夜班经理对逼近的暴风雨感到深深的忧虑。
突然的停电让整个装卸区陷入了黑暗。
由于停电的表面原因仍然未知，这恐怕会使本就混乱的局面进一步恶化。
小公司在对抗大型物流企业时很难享有任何公平竞争的环境。
然而，这种不公并不能为这名主管持续的无能开脱。
他未能妥善固定好重型板条箱。
任何进一步的延误只会激怒在外面等候的卡车司机。
一名不耐烦的司机对人类操作员难免犯错发表了一些无端的嘲讽。
显然，升级安全系统已不再被视为可有可无的择期之选。

passages.title: 木偶剧团的告别演出
en: The old puppeteer worked in silence, hoping the pain in his wrists would soon {{abate}}.
Packing up the workshop was an incredibly {{arduous}} task.
He stopped to dust off a carved wooden horse.
He possessed rare {{humility}}, never seeking praise even when his {{artful}} designs won awards.
The troupe's fortunes used to {{oscillate}} between sold-out tours and near bankruptcy.
Now, endless {{red-tape}} had forced them to vacate the historic theater.
A few {{fervent}} fans stood in the rain and watched the last {{rickety}} prop wagon roll past.
The stage manager's {{interjection}}, when it came, cut straight across his thoughts.
She smiled sadly and turned off the overhead lights.
His final movements {{dovetail|dovetailed}} perfectly with the closing music.
zh: 老木偶师默默地工作着，只盼手腕上的疼痛能尽快缓解。
打包收拾这间工作室是一项极其艰苦的任务。
他停下来，拍去一匹雕花木马上的灰尘。
他拥有一种罕见的谦逊，即使他那精巧的设计屡获殊荣也从不寻求赞美。
剧团的命运曾经在门票售罄的巡演和濒临破产之间反复摇摆。
如今，没完没了的繁文缛节迫使他们腾出这座历史悠久的剧院。
几名狂热的粉丝站在雨里，看着最后一辆快散架的道具车滚过。
舞台监督那句插话来的时候，正好把他的思绪拦腰截断。
她悲伤地笑了笑，关掉了顶灯。
他最后的动作与闭幕音乐完美吻合。

passages.title: 玻璃窑的熄火期
en: Cooling down this massive industrial furnace is quite {{formidable}}.
It is {{incumbent}} upon the engineers to monitor the temperature constantly.
Their {{de-facto}} manager showed her {{penchant}} for traditional blowing techniques.
She walked across the glowing shop floor to inspect the valves.
The most {{astute}} technician on the floor noticed a micro-fracture forming along the main pipe.
Rushing the process would be {{expedient}} but could ruin the crystals.
Using cheap fuel would inevitably {{debase}} the purity of their glass.
Their strict {{fidelity}} to the century-old recipe earned them international awards.
The team gathered around the control panel in silence.
Rather than direct measurement, they used sensors to {{interpolate}} the internal pressure and relied on {{inferential}} models.
zh: 让这座巨大的工业熔炉冷却下来是相当令人敬畏的挑战。
工程师们有责任不断监控温度。
他们实际上的管理人展现了她对传统吹制技术的偏爱。
她穿过红光闪烁的车间去检查阀门。
车间里最机敏的那位技工发现主管道上正在生出一道微裂纹。
加快进度固然方便，但可能会毁掉这些水晶。
使用廉价燃料不可避免地会降低他们玻璃的纯度。
他们对百年配方的严格忠实，为他们赢得了国际奖项。
团队成员在控制面板周围默默地聚集起来。
他们没有直接测量，而是使用传感器来插值计算内部压力，并依赖推论模型。

passages.title: 水坝的汛期
en: The control room was in absolute {{turmoil}} as the water levels rose dangerously high.
Decades of neglected maintenance had allowed rust to {{permeate}} the primary floodgates.
They finally had to {{bite-the-bullet}} and open the emergency spillway.
It was truly {{outmoded}}, relying on giant iron wheels instead of digital switches.
Such {{clamor}} of the rushing water made it impossible to hear the radio dispatch.
The {{unwitting}} junior staffer who delayed the alert gave the mayor all the excuse he needed to {{malign}} the engineers.
Despite this, the chief engineer was {{magnanimous}}, forgiving the honest mistake immediately.
The power flickered and went out completely.
That {{ostentatious}} visitor center was flooded, but their plan to reinforce the valley wall had finally come to {{fruition}}.
The storm raged on throughout the long night.
zh: 随着水位升至危险的高度，控制室里陷入了彻底的混乱。
几十年来被忽视的维护，使得铁锈渗入了主防洪闸。
他们最终不得不硬着头皮，打开紧急溢洪道。
那确实是一个过时的系统，依赖巨大的铁轮而不是数字开关。
湍急水流的这种喧闹声让他们根本听不清无线电调度。
那位并不知情的年轻职员把警报耽搁了下来，市长要的正是这个借口，转头就把工程师们中伤了一遍。
尽管如此，总工程师还是宽宏大量的，立刻原谅了这个无心之失。
电源闪烁了一下，然后彻底断了。
那座炫耀的游客中心被淹没了，但他们加固山谷岩壁的计划终于结出了成果。
暴风雨在漫长的夜晚继续肆虐。

passages.title: 老酒厂的最后一批货
en: Aging wine requires highly {{meticulous}} tracking of temperature and humidity.
The cellar master was viewed as some {{benevolent}} guardian by the apprentices.
Dust particles danced in the narrow shafts of sunlight.
Unfortunately, the barrels were stacked in a very {{haphazard}} arrangement, and one clumsy movement could cause a cask to {{topple}}.
They managed to {{surmount}} the logistical nightmare just before the harvest season.
Nobody wanted to stay late on a Friday evening.
The new management introduced a digital inventory system, promoting it as their {{panacea}}.
The software came with the sort of {{caveat}} nobody reads until too late — every old record had to be keyed in by hand, which turned out to be {{onerous}} beyond anyone's estimate.
They decided to {{abridge}} the historical logs to save time.
The stressful transition gave the manager stomach issues, forcing him to take a mild {{laxative}}.
zh: 酿造陈年葡萄酒，得一丝不苟地把温度和湿度一笔笔记下来。
这位酒窖主管被学徒们视为某种仁慈的守护者。
灰尘颗粒在狭窄的阳光光束中飞舞。
不幸的是，木桶的堆放方式非常杂乱无章，一个笨拙的动作就可能导致木桶倒塌。
他们设法在收获季节前克服了后勤方面的噩梦。
没有人想在星期五晚上留下来加班。
新管理层引入了一套数字库存系统，并将其宣传为他们的万灵药。
这套软件附了一条没人会认真看的但书——所有旧记录都得手工录入，而这件事的繁重程度超出了所有人的估计。
他们决定删节历史日志以节省时间。
压力巨大的过渡期导致经理出现了胃部问题，迫使他服用了一种温和的泻药。

passages.title: 搜救犬基地的考核
en: That {{philanthropic}} organization donated three new obstacle courses to the dog facility.
During the drill, heavy rain proved to be a major {{hindrance}} for the younger pups.
Demand for certified tracking dogs surged dramatically {{in-the-wake-of}} the recent earthquake.
A veteran trainer spoke with admirable {{candor}} about the high failure rate.
She explained that any {{cataclysmic}} disaster zone overwhelms dogs without solid nerve control.
The muddy field made the final sprint extremely difficult.
One handler had such {{temerity}} to argue against her strict grading methods, and their exchange quickly grew {{acrimonious}}.
Everyone else remained perfectly quiet.
He wanted his retriever to pass, hoping the badge would {{efface}} their past mistakes and fulfill what they {{yearn}} for.
Despite the stress, the lead dog gave a surprisingly {{lucid}} demonstration of scent tracking.
zh: 那家慈善机构向这个犬类设施捐赠了三个新的障碍训练场。
测试期间，大雨被证明是对较小幼犬的一大障碍。
对认证追踪犬的需求在那场最近的地震之后急剧飙升。
一位资深训练员以令人钦佩的坦率谈论了那居高不下的淘汰率。
她解释说，任何灾难性的事故现场都会压垮那些没有稳固神经控制力的狗。
泥泞的场地让最后的冲刺变得极其困难。
一名训导员竟然有如此鲁莽的胆量去反驳她那严格的评分方法，他们的交锋迅速变得言辞激烈且充满怨恨。
其他所有人都保持着绝对的安静。
他希望他的猎犬能够通过，期盼这枚徽章能抹去他们过去的失误，并实现他们所渴望的目标。
尽管压力巨大，那只领头犬还是给出了一场极其清晰的气味追踪示范。

passages.title: 诊所医生的辞职信
en: Dr. Vance's sudden departure caused a massive {{upheaval}} at the valley clinic, leaving a gap that felt truly {{irreparable}}.
He had been their only physician for over twenty years.
His resignation letter was shocking in its {{brevity}}, offering no clues about his true motives.
The town council soon reached a bitter {{impasse}} over how to handle the sudden vacancy.
Some argued his exit was clearly {{premeditated}}, as he had been shipping his medical textbooks away since autumn.
They tried to push through a single {{atomic}} resolution to hire a replacement or shut the doors forever.
This harsh ultimatum made the elder members rather {{petulant}}, leading them to take {{circuitous}} routes just to avoid the mayor.
Instead of trying to {{elucidate}} the clinic's budget deficit, the mayor simply stormed out of the hall.
Given the grueling hours Vance had worked, few could truly {{begrudge}} him his rest.
By December, the building sat empty under the heavy snow.
zh: 万斯医生的突然离职在山谷诊所引起了一场大地震，他留下的空缺让人觉得根本无法弥补。
二十多年来，他一直是这里唯一的医生。
他的辞职信简短得令人震惊，丝毫没有透露他真正的动机。
镇议会很快就在如何处理这个突发空缺的问题上陷入了痛苦的僵局。
有人认为他的离开显然是蓄谋已久的，因为他从秋天起就把自己的医学书寄走了。
他们试图强行通过一项不可分割的决议：要么马上雇个继任者，要么永远关门。
这种严苛的最后通牒让几位年长的委员耍起了小脾气，他们甚至故意绕远路，就为了躲开镇长。
镇长并没有试图去阐明诊所的预算赤字，而是直接摔门离开了大厅。
考虑到万斯以前那繁重的工作时间，很少有人会真的嫉妒他能得到休息。
到了十二月，那栋建筑就在大雪中空置着。

passages.title: 边境线上的查验
en: The new border guards showed remarkable {{adaptability}} when facing the endless stream of night cargo.
They had to be extremely {{circumspect}} about which trucks to search, as random delays could easily {{incite}} riots among the drivers.
One missing stamp was a common {{impediment}} that kept a vehicle waiting until dawn.
In the guardhouse, the captain was busy trying to {{collate}} the week's transit logs.
He noticed that {{precipitous}} drop in declared timber shipments from the northern province.
He knew that bending the rules was that dangerous {{slippery-slope}} that would lead to massive smuggling networks.
A rookie officer caught one driver making some {{surreptitious}} phone call to the region's highly {{preeminent}} logistics manager.
However, the {{inexorable}} advance of the patrol dogs toward his tires told a different story.
Before the sun came up, the entire convoy was seized.
zh: 新来的边防哨兵在面对夜间源源不断的货运车流时，展现出了惊人的适应能力。
他们在决定搜查哪辆卡车时必须极为慎重，因为随意的延误很容易在司机中煽动起骚乱。
漏盖一个章就是常见的障碍，会让一辆车一直等到天亮。
在警卫室里，队长正忙着整理这一周的通行日志。
他注意到来自北方省份的申报木材运输量出现了那般断崖式的下跌。
他深知对小错视而不见就是那种一旦开头就收不住的做法，最终会滋生出庞大的走私网络。
一名新来的警员逮到一个司机躲在锈迹斑斑的集装箱后头，偷偷摸摸地给本地区首屈一指的物流经理打电话。
然而，巡逻犬朝着他的车胎不可阻挡地逼近，说明事情绝没那么简单。
太阳升起之前，整个车队都被扣押了。

passages.title: 面包房里的叛逆
en: For decades the family bakery ran as the founder's own {{autocracy}}, and nothing left the oven that he had not approved.
This suffocating management style created deep {{malaise}} among the night shift workers.
Their wages were hardly {{commensurate}} with the grueling hours they spent kneading dough.
During the morning meeting, the head baker offered highly {{incisive}} criticisms about the recipes, but the owner just offered another tired {{platitude}}.
They knew {{more-often-than-not}} that suggesting changes would only make the old man completely {{intransigent}}.
That morning, however, the pastry chef decided to {{veer}} from the traditional menu.
Doing so would deliberately {{contravene}} the shop's most sacred handbook.
He baked some delightfully {{unpretentious}} rustic loaves using leftover rye.
Customers smelled the fresh crust from the street.
By noon, every single loaf was sold out.
zh: 几十年来，这家家族面包房就是创始人一个人的专制王国，没有一炉面包是未经他点头出得了炉的。
这种令人窒息的管理风格在夜班工人中引发了一种深深的萎靡情绪。
他们揉面揉到深夜，拿到的工资跟这些辛苦的工时完全不相称。
在早会上，面包师领班对那些陈旧的配方提出了非常一针见血的批评，但老板却只是抛出了另一句老生常谈的套话。
他们知道，十有八九，提出修改建议只会让这老头变得越发固执己见。
然而那天早上，糕点主管决定突然转向，不按传统菜单来做。
这样做会公然违反店里最神圣的员工手册。
他用剩下的黑麦烤出了一些非常朴实无华的乡村面包。
顾客们在街上就闻到了新鲜的面包皮香味。
到了中午，所有面包都被抢购一空。

passages.title: 脆弱的书页
en: The chief archivist liked to gently {{allude}} to the dark history behind the library's oldest manuscript.
Restoring the fragile parchment was incredibly {{painstaking}} work that required steady hands.
Even one moment of careless {{complacency}} could easily {{incapacitate}} the entire preservation effort.
They had to scrape away every microscopic {{impurity}} from the vellum surface.
If the humidity in the room dropped too {{precipitously}}, the ancient binding would crack.
The task was {{by-no-means}} finished, as hundreds of pages still needed treatment.
Some visiting scholars tried to frankly {{belittle}} the slow progress, showing profound {{undervaluation}} of the quiet labor involved in saving history.
Finally, when the restored book was unveiled, the crowd broke into utterly {{rapturous}} applause.
The long months of silence had at last paid off.
Nobody questioned their methods ever again.
zh: 首席档案馆长总喜欢委婉地暗指图书馆那本最古老手稿背后的黑暗历史。
修复脆弱的羊皮纸是一项极其煞费苦心的工作，需要一双极其稳当的手。
哪怕是一瞬间粗心大意的自满，都很容易让整个保护工作付诸东流。
他们必须刮掉牛皮纸表面上每一个微小的杂质。
如果房间里的湿度下降得过于急剧，那古老的装订就会开裂。
这项任务绝没有完成，因为还有数百页需要处理。
一些来访的学者毫不客气地贬低他们缓慢的进度，这暴露出他们对拯救历史这种默默无闻的劳动长期存在低估。
最后，当这本修复好的书展出时，人群中爆发出极其狂喜的掌声。
漫长几个月的沉默终于得到了回报。
再也没有人质疑过他们的方法。

passages.title: 风雪中的救援
en: Operating the high-altitude rescue station meant facing brutal {{adversity}} on a daily basis.
The budget was so tight, making their outdated equipment seem practically {{obscene}}.
During winter storms, stranded hikers would usually {{congregate}} near the thermal vents.
The crew could always sense every {{impending}} avalanche before the sirens even wailed.
Some climbers had a reckless {{predisposition}} to ignore warning signs entirely.
{{that-said}}, the captain was highly {{reticent}} about criticizing victims in front of reporters.
He preferred to fiercely {{wrangle}} with local politicians over funding.
The most {{recalcitrant}} of the officials argued that the town was already facing {{destitution}} and could not afford new snowmobiles.
The captain simply pointed to his map of danger zones and walked out.
His silent protest left the council chamber completely speechless.
zh: 运营这座高海拔救援站意味着每天都要面对残酷的逆境。
预算非常紧张，使得他们那些过时的设备看起来简直是不堪入目。
在冬季风暴中，被困的徒步旅行者通常会聚集在热气孔附近。
救援队总能在警报声响起之前就察觉到每一次迫近的雪崩。
有些登山者有一种不计后果的倾向，完全无视警告标志。
话虽如此，队长在记者面前对批评受害者显得非常沉默寡言。
他宁愿为了资金问题与当地政客激烈争吵。
官员里最顽固不化的那一位辩称，镇上已经穷得快揭不开锅，买不起新雪地摩托。
队长只是指了指他的危险区域地图，然后走了出去。
他的无声抗议让整个议会大厅鸦雀无声。

passages.title: 南坡上的十一箱蜂
en: Vera kept eleven hives on the south slope, and she was frankly {{agnostic}} about most of what the old beekeepers told her.
She would not {{perpetuate}} the story that you had to tell the bees when someone in the house died, though she never quite laughed at anyone who did.

That April it rained for nineteen days, weather in no way {{conducive}} to a strong colony, and Petar next door — {{insomniac}} since his wife's illness — watched her carry sugar syrup up the slope at four in the morning.
He was the first to see that one hive had turned {{perverse}}, its workers carrying pollen out of the box instead of into it.
Vera had no patience for the {{mystique}} the county association wrapped around swarm behaviour, and she said so at the spring meeting, at length.
Two weeks later a buyer from the city offered four times the going rate for the whole apiary.
She read {{ulterior}} motives into the offer at once, and she was right — the man wanted the slope, not the bees.
Petar was {{ardent}} on her behalf in a way she found embarrassing, and drove to the registry office himself; Vera stayed {{dispassionate}} and asked only to see the deed.
Neither of them slept much that week.
In the end she {{consign|consigned}} nine hives to a school on the far side of the valley, kept two, and the story about telling the bees went with them.
zh: 薇拉在南坡上养着十一箱蜂，老养蜂人传下来的那些说法，她大多是不置可否的。
家里死了人要去跟蜜蜂说一声——这种说法她不肯往下传，可也从没真的笑话过谁。
那年四月下了十九天雨，这种天气对蜂群的壮大毫无助益；隔壁的彼得——自妻子病后就一直失眠——看着她凌晨四点往坡上扛糖浆。
最先看出有一箱不对劲的是他：那箱的工蜂偏要反着来，把花粉往箱外搬，而不是往里搬。
县养蜂协会给分蜂行为裹上的那层神秘色彩，薇拉一点也不买账，春季会上她当众说了，还说了很久。
两周后，城里来了个买家，出的价是行情的四倍，要把整个蜂场盘下来。
她当场就读出了这背后别有用心——她没猜错，那人要的是这片坡地，不是蜜蜂。
彼得替她热心得让她有些难为情，自己开车跑了一趟登记处；薇拉倒是冷静得不带情绪，只要求看一眼地契。
那一周他们俩都没怎么睡。
最后她把九箱蜂托付给了山谷那头的一所学校，自己留下两箱——那个要跟蜜蜂说话的故事，也跟着一起去了。

passages.title: 街角当铺的旧物
en: The eccentric owner had a strange {{affinity}} for collecting forgotten heirlooms.
For him, preserving the history of each item was absolutely {{paramount}}.
Every rusted pocket watch carried a heavy {{connotation}} of lost time and broken promises.
One dusty corner was filled with seemingly {{innocuous}} trinkets alongside bizarre {{taxidermy}} owls.
He considered his cluttered store the highly {{quintessential}} example of urban archaeology.
Slowly, wild rumors began to {{percolate}} through the neighborhood about his hidden wealth.
A newly arrived antique mirror felt like an incredibly {{auspicious}} find, though he worried the current recession might quickly {{impoverish}} his loyal customers.
He placed the mirror in the window, hoping its shiny surface would serve as some {{subliminal}} invitation.
The bell above the door finally rang.
A shadowy figure stepped out of the rain.
zh: 这位古怪的老板对收集被遗忘的传家宝有一种奇特的偏爱。
对他来说，保存每件物品的历史是至关重要的。
每一块生锈的怀表都带有关于逝去时光和破碎承诺的沉重内涵。
一个满是灰尘的角落里堆满了看似无害的小玩意，旁边还有些稀奇古怪的动物标本。
他认为自己这家杂乱的店铺是城市考古学最典型的代表。
渐渐地，关于他隐藏财富的疯狂传言开始在街坊邻里间渗透流传。
新到的一面古董镜子，怎么看都像个极吉利的兆头——尽管他担心眼下的经济下行会很快让老主顾们手头拮据。
他把镜子放在橱窗里，希望它闪亮的表面能作为某种潜意识的邀请。
门上的铃铛终于响了。
一个黑影从雨中走了进来。

passages.title: 旧书店里的真伪之争
en: The old man had {{preside|presided}} over the dusty bookstore for forty years, trusting his own eyes more than any certificate.
So it {{appall|appalled}} him to find a fake first edition sitting right in his display case.
The seller's {{outlandish}} story about discovering the manuscript in a ruined castle was clearly a lie.
He knew any {{conscientious}} dealer would destroy it, but the forgery itself showed such remarkable {{ingenuity}} that he couldn't bear to.
He locked the leather-bound book in his bottom drawer, hiding it from the world.
He simply told his assistant that the item was not for sale.
Maintaining the lie that his collection was completely flawless had become {{untenable}} anyway.
By an unwritten {{fiat}}, the guild would hold him {{culpable}} if they ever found out he sold it.
To testify to its authenticity now would essentially be {{perjury}}.
This single volume {{epitomize|epitomized}} the quiet corruption that was slowly ruining his trade.
zh: 老人掌管这家积灰的旧书店已有四十年，他相信自己的眼睛胜过任何证书。
因此，当他发现自己的展示柜里竟然摆着一本伪造的初版书时，他感到无比震惊。
卖家声称在废墟城堡中发现这份手稿的离谱故事，显然是个谎言。
他深知任何尽责的古董商都会将其销毁，但这件赝品本身展现出的非凡巧思让他实在于心不忍。
他把这本真皮装帧的书锁在了最下面的抽屉里，将它对世人隐藏起来。
他只是告诉他的助手那件物品不卖。
无论如何，想要维持所有藏品绝对完美无瑕的谎言已经变得站不住脚了。
根据一项不成文的命令，如果行会发现他卖掉了这本书，就会认定他负有过失责任。
如果现在去证明它的真实性，那基本上就等同于作伪证。
这孤零零的一册书集中体现了那种正在慢慢毁掉他这行的无声腐败。

passages.title: 寄宿学校的深夜丑闻
en: The elite boarding school boasted modern {{amenity|amenities}} but maintained a toxic culture among the students.
A group of older boys constantly {{persecute|persecuted}} anyone who didn't fit into their strict social hierarchy.
When the headmaster finally intervened, his {{imperious}} lecture in the dining hall shocked everyone into silence.
He read aloud a highly {{contrived}} apology letter, making the bullies stand on the stage looking completely {{abashed}}.
The silence in the room was heavy and uncomfortable.
However, hidden camera footage soon {{incriminate|incriminated}} the school's top swimmer, completely overshadowing his athletic {{prowess}}.
The police arrived on campus early the next morning.
He was formally expelled and charged with public {{indecency}}.
{{juxtapose|Juxtaposing}} his pristine academic record with his secret crimes left the staff deeply disturbed.
The administration's sudden commitment to transparency was considered {{laudable}}, but it came far too late for the victims.
zh: 这所精英寄宿学校标榜着现代化的便利设施，却在学生中维持着一种有害的文化。
一群高年级男生经常欺压任何不符合他们严格社交阶层的人。
当校长终于介入时，他在食堂里那番傲慢专横的训话让所有人震惊得哑口无言。
他大声朗读了一封极其做作的道歉信，让那些霸凌者站在台上显得十分窘迫。
房间里的沉默显得沉重而令人不安。
然而，隐藏摄像头的录像很快就牵连了学校的顶尖游泳选手，完全掩盖了他在体育上的高超技能。
警察在第二天一大早就抵达了校园。
他被正式开除，并被指控有伤风化。
将他完美无瑕的学业成绩与他秘密的罪行并置对比，让教职员工感到深深的不安。
校方突然承诺保持透明被认为是值得称赞的，但对受害者来说实在太晚了。

passages.title: 墓园的扩建争议
en: The city planners decided to {{raze}} the old administrative building to make room for more graves.
They kept up their {{pretense}} that it was a necessary modernization project.
The demolition excavators were already parked down the street.
The neighbors grew {{indignant}} because they suspected the manager had {{collude|colluded}} with a private real estate firm.
At the cemetery gates, an elderly florist launched into a bitter {{harangue}} against the greedy officials.
She repeated her grandmother's original lease agreement {{verbatim}}, proving her right to stay.
Heavy rain began to fall on the protesters.
The security guards listened in {{perplexity}}, while nobody gave any {{credence}} to the manager's promises of fair compensation.
His {{overbearing}} attitude only made the crowd shout louder in protest.
Sensing that {{opportune}} moment, a local journalist stepped up with a camera to record the scene.
zh: 城市规划者决定将旧的行政楼夷为平地，腾出空间修建更多墓地。
他们一直伪装这是一项必要的现代化工程。
拆除用的挖掘机已经停在了街道尽头。
附近居民感到愤愤不平，因为他们怀疑经理与一家私营房地产公司暗中勾结。
在墓园大门外，一位年迈的花商对贪婪的官员发表了长篇大论的痛斥。
她一字不差地背诵了她祖母最初的租赁协议，证明了她有权留下来。
大雨开始落在抗议者的身上。
保安们满脸困惑地听着，而没有人相信经理关于公平赔偿的承诺。
他那盛气凌人的态度只让抗议的人群喊得更大声。
感觉到那个恰好的时机，一名当地记者拿着相机走上前来记录下了这一幕。

passages.title: 拳馆里的卷土重来
en: This {{disparity}} in skill between the veteran boxer and the young challenger was obvious.
Still {{convalescent}} from a broken rib, the older fighter had been away from the ring for a year.
The gym owner, {{barefaced}} about the money from the start, took the {{unilateral}} decision to schedule the match anyway.
Surrounded by {{sycophant|sycophants}}, the young champion spared his opponent only the most {{cursory}} glance at the weigh-in.
The crowd roared as the lights dimmed in the arena.
However, the veteran planned to {{protract}} the fight, dragging it into the later rounds.
He knew the younger man would eventually tire and his defense would {{slacken}}.
Blood dripped from the challenger's nose by the eighth round.
When the final bell rang, the stunning knockout left that {{indelible}} mark on boxing history.
The victory completely {{vindicate|vindicated}} the old fighter's relentless training methods.
zh: 这位老将与年轻挑战者之间在技巧上的这种差距显而易见。
由于肋骨骨折仍处于康复期，这位老拳手已经离开拳台一年了。
健身房老板从一开始就毫不掩饰是冲着钱来的，单方面拍板照常安排这场比赛。
被一群马屁精围着的年轻冠军，在称重时只极其草草地瞥了对手一眼。
当竞技场的灯光暗下时，人群发出了震耳欲聋的欢呼声。
然而，老将计划拖延比赛，将其拖入后面的回合。
他知道那个年轻人最终会疲惫不堪，防守也会随之松懈。
到了第八回合，鲜血从挑战者的鼻子里滴落下来。
当终场铃声响起时，那次令人震惊的击倒在拳击史上留下了不可磨灭的印记。
这场胜利彻底证明了这位老拳手那残酷的训练方法是绝对正确的。

passages.title: 火山观测站的警告
en: The massive volcano had remained completely {{inert}} for nearly three centuries.
Most geologists treated the daily seismic checks as just another {{perfunctory}} task.
When the ground finally began to shake, the team scrambled to execute their {{contingency}} plan.
The station's {{pompous}} lead scientist delivered a sharp {{rebuke}} to anyone who suggested an evacuation.
Unable to {{reconcile}} the rapidly climbing temperatures with the calm surface, the staff grew panicked.
The local mayor, showing surprising {{prudence}}, ordered the roads closed anyway.
He had to {{concoct}} some {{devious}} story about a bridge repair project to safely move tourists away.
Ash began to fall from the sky like gray snow.
Sirens wailed across the empty valley.
Once the eruption started, the lava flow proved to be an utterly {{intractable}} force, consuming everything in its path.
zh: 这座巨大的火山已经近三个世纪一动不动、毫无生气了。
大多数地质学家都把日常的地震检查看作是又一个例行公事的敷衍任务。
当地面终于开始震动时，团队手忙脚乱地开始执行他们的应急预案。
观测站那位自命不凡的首席科学家，谁提撤离就严厉训斥谁。
工作人员无法将急剧攀升的温度与平静的地表调和起来，心里变得越来越恐慌。
当地市长展现出了令人惊讶的审慎，无论如何还是下令封锁了道路。
他不得不编造某个狡猾的桥梁维修工程借口，以安全地将游客转移走。
火山灰像灰色的雪一样从天空中飘落。
警报声在空荡荡的山谷中回荡。
一旦火山爆发开始，熔岩流就被证明是一股极其难以阻挡的力量，吞噬了沿途的一切。

passages.title: 落潮时的轰鸣
en: The seasonal shutdown of the coastal turbines brought together teams with {{disparate}} backgrounds.
Engineers from the capital shared cramped quarters with local divers, creating an atmosphere {{reminiscent}} of a frontier camp.
They worked twelve-hour shifts deep inside the drained concrete chambers.
One older mechanic tried to {{entreat}} his supervisor for a break, hoping to {{forestall}} exhaustion before the night rotation.
But the strict maintenance schedule allowed no room for rest.
The unforgiving environment felt almost {{malevolent}}, pushing everyone to their physical limits.
The headquarters inspector, known to be {{erudite}}, struggled to decipher the rusted schematics.
A sudden crack in the main valve threatened to {{thwart}} their progress.
To fix the mechanism, a diver burdened by his {{disreputable}} past volunteered for the risky underwater weld.
When he finished, no one doubted its {{efficacy}}, his steady hands mimicking a doctor administering {{anesthesia}}.
zh: 沿海涡轮机的季节性停机将背景迥然不同的几支队伍聚在了此处。
首都工程师和本地潜水员挤在狭小的宿舍里，这种氛围让人联想到边疆营地。
他们在排干水的混凝土腔室内轮班干上十二个小时。
一位老机修工试图恳求主管给个休息时间，指望在夜班前先发制人地防止体力透支。
但严苛的检修进度表容不得半点喘息。
无情的环境几乎透着一股恶意，把每个人的身体逼到了极限。
那位向来以博学著称的总部视察员，在生锈的图纸面前也一筹莫展。
主阀门上突然出现的一道裂缝险些阻挠了他们的进度。
为了修复该装置，一名背负着不光彩过去的潜水员主动请缨，接下了危险的水下焊接任务。
完工后，再没人怀疑那道焊缝的功效，他那双稳当的手如同正在实施麻醉的医生。

passages.title: 秋风中的终点线
en: A smell of stale beer and damp earth seemed to {{pervade}} the grandstand during its final autumn.
Developers had purchased the land months ago due to a zoning board's {{oversight}}.
The remaining jockeys knew their jobs would disappear by November.
His sudden burst of speed felt {{tantalizing}}, earning cheers instead of strict {{reprimand}} for ignoring the trainer's pace.
Such reckless behavior proved {{detrimental}} to his horse's joints.
The management installed new cameras near the stables as mere {{deterrence}} against late-night tampering.
No one bothered to watch the fuzzy black-and-white footage anyway.
In a rare moment of {{introspection}}, the track owner regretted selling out to those {{acquisitive}} real estate firms.
Yet his wife remained {{steadfast}}, packing up decades of trophies into cardboard boxes.
Local newspapers began to {{eulogize}} the venue weeks before the last gates ever opened.
zh: 在它最后一个秋季里，看台上似乎弥漫着陈腐啤酒和潮湿泥土的气味。
几个月前，由于分区委员会的一次疏忽，开发商已经买下了这块地。
留下来的骑师们心里清楚，他们的饭碗到十一月就会消失。
他那突如其来的爆发速度颇具诱惑力，非但没有因为无视练马师的节奏而招致严厉训斥，反而赢得了阵阵喝彩。
这种鲁莽的行为证明对他的马匹关节是有害的。
管理层在马厩附近安装了新摄像头，仅仅作为对深夜动动手脚的威慑。
反正根本没人去费心看那模糊的黑白录像。
在一次难得的自我反思中，赛马场老板后悔把产业卖给了那些贪婪的房地产公司。
然而他的妻子依然坚定不移，把几十年来赢得的奖杯打包进纸箱里。
甚至在最后一场比赛开闸的几周前，地方报纸就开始颂扬这个场地了。

passages.title: 凌晨三点的闸杆
en: The graveyard shift on the turnpike always attracted drivers with {{erratic}} habits.
One frustrated trucker voiced his {{dissent}} over the new automated card readers.
The blinking red error lights felt {{analogous}} to a neon sign screaming for help.
The booth attendant answered with her {{insouciant}} shrug, holding no {{animosity}} toward the screaming man.
Through the glass, she decided to {{mime}} the motion of inserting the chip.
He pounded on the steering wheel while the cars piled up behind him.
That machine remained stubborn, acting like an untamed, {{refractory}} patient refusing medicine.
To keep traffic moving, she had to {{acquiesce}} and open the barrier, hoping her boss would {{gratify}} her choice later.
The trucker sped off into the darkness without a word of thanks.
She never expected anyone to {{reciprocate}} her small favors on this desolate highway.
zh: 收费站的午夜班总是会招来些驾驶习惯飘忽不定的司机。
一名沮丧的卡车司机对新安装的自动读卡器表达了异议。
闪烁的红色故障灯就像是在大声呼救的霓虹灯招牌。
收费员用她那满不在乎的耸肩作为回应，对那个大喊大叫的男人没带半点敌意。
隔着玻璃，她决定用哑剧般的动作模仿插入芯片的过程。
他使劲砸着方向盘，而他身后的汽车已经排成了长龙。
那台机器依然无动于衷，活像个未经驯服、拒绝吃药的顽固病人。
为了让车流继续前进，她只好默许放行并升起起落杆，希望老板事后能对她的决定感到满意。
卡车司机连句道谢的话都没说，便加速消失在黑暗中。
她也从未指望过在这条荒凉的高速公路上，会有人来回报她的小恩小惠。

passages.title: 传送带上的雪花
en: The union leaders met upstairs to {{ratify}} the holiday overtime agreement.
Down on the floor, exhaustion was already {{endemic}} among the seasonal workers.
Mountains of mismatched boxes piled up near the loading docks.
The junior sorters seemed to {{revere}} the shift manager for his {{adroit}} handling of fragile packages.
He never grew {{testy}}, even when someone dropped a box of glass ornaments.
Management tried to {{extrapolate}} next week's volume from the current chaos.
They hired extra trucks from private fleets to ease the backlog.
These outside drivers showed nothing but {{mercenary}} motives, charging double to rescue any {{hapless}} dispatcher trapped by the schedule.
Despite the pressure, the break room maintained its {{congenial}} atmosphere around the coffee machine.
One supervisor drank six cups and experienced terrifying {{palpitation|palpitations}} right before dawn.
zh: 工会领导人们在楼上开会，正式批准了节日加班协议。
而在楼下的分拣大厅里，临时工之间早已弥漫着难以根除的疲惫感。
堆积如山的规格不一的纸箱在装卸区附近越垒越高。
初级分拣员们似乎对轮班经理充满敬仰，因为他处理易碎包裹的手法极为机敏。
哪怕有人摔烂了一整盒玻璃装饰品，他也从不变得暴躁。
管理层试图从眼前的混乱中推断出下周的业务量。
他们从私人车队雇了额外的卡车来缓解积压。
这些外面的司机动机极其唯利是图，开出双倍价钱来拯救任何被日程表困住的倒霉调度员。
尽管压力重重，休息室的咖啡机旁依然保持着一种意气相投的友善氛围。
一位主管喝了六杯咖啡，结果在黎明前经历了可怕的心悸。

passages.title: 孢子的抗争
en: The subterranean farm resembled this {{monolithic}} maze of concrete corridors.
Heavy rains began to {{inundate}} the lower cultivation chambers.
Workers rushed to stack the precious spore bags on higher shelves.
One supervisor took the chaotic situation as a personal {{affront}}, deciding to {{embroil}} everyone in a shouting match.
He lacked even the most {{rudimentary}} leadership skills.
The humidity made the air thick and difficult to breathe.
The team's {{gregarious}} technician grew silent, noticing that {{incipient}} crack in the ceiling.
Management promised them {{equitable}} bonuses for saving the harvest.
They also refused to {{remunerate}} anyone who left the flooded zone early.
Two exhausted laborers ended up in the site's makeshift {{infirmary}}.
zh: 这座地下农场就像是这庞大一体的混凝土迷宫。
大雨开始淹没底部的几个栽培室。
工人们赶紧把珍贵的孢子袋堆到更高的架子上。
一名主管把这种混乱局面视为对个人的冒犯，决定把所有人都卷入一场骂战。
他甚至连最基本的领导能力都不具备。
湿气让空气变得浑浊，令人呼吸困难。
团队里那位平时爱交际的技术员安静了下来，注意到了天花板上那道刚刚出现的裂缝。
管理层承诺，为了拯救这次收成，会给他们发放公平的奖金。
他们还拒绝给任何提前离开洪水区的人支付报酬。
两名筋疲力尽的劳工最终躺进了工地的临时医务室。

passages.title: 干涸的瓷砖
en: The city council decided to shut down the historic aquatic center.
The facility manager, our {{genial}} leader, remained {{oblivious}} to the true motives driving the closure.
He thought it was just a plumbing issue, missing widespread, {{systemic}} rot in the city budget.
A local journalist refused to {{belabor}} the obvious financial deficit.
She managed to {{intersperse}} her final article with interviews from former lifeguards.
One specific document became their {{smoking-gun}}, revealing how the mayor dodged those {{exacting}} safety inspections.
Citizens gathered outside the drained pool holding candles.
They observed deep, {{reverent}} silence for the place where they learned to swim.
Prosecutors urged the judge to show no {{leniency}} toward the corrupt officials.
A grand jury will {{indict}} the responsible politicians next week.
zh: 市议会决定关闭这座历史悠久的水上中心。
设施经理，我们和蔼可亲的领导，对推动关停的真正动机依然浑然不觉。
他以为那不过是管道问题，却没看到市府预算中那种系统性的腐败。
一名当地记者拒绝再去喋喋不休地强调那个显而易见的财务缺口。
她设法在最后一篇报道中穿插了对前救生员们的采访。
真正成了铁证的是一份文件,上面写着市长当初是怎么把那几道严苛的安检绕过去的。
市民们拿着蜡烛聚集在排干水的泳池外。
他们为这个教会自己游泳的地方保持着深深的、虔诚的沉默。
检察官敦促法官对这些腐败官员不要给予任何宽大处理。
一个大陪审团将于下周起诉那些负有责任的政客。

passages.title: 悬崖边的印章
en: Securing the new explosives license became a massive bureaucratic {{odyssey}}.
The quarry stood right next to a protected wildlife reserve.
Our {{domineering}} regional director tried to {{placate}} the angry environmentalists with vague promises.
Those activists argued that the rock walls remained {{precarious}}.
The geology department's eager {{neophyte}} drafted the preliminary safety report.
His tiny sensors were so {{unobtrusive}} that the wildlife ignored them.
The heavy drill machines sat idle for three full weeks.
Corporate {{procurement}} refused to buy more dynamite until they could {{delve}} into the updated rules.
They believed their legal team was {{infallible}}.
At last, the state board chose to {{concur}} with the safety findings, granting the final approval.
zh: 拿到新的炸药许可成了一场漫长曲折的官僚主义征途。
采石场紧挨着一个受保护的野生动物保护区。
我们那位专横的区域总监试图用含糊的承诺来安抚愤怒的环保人士。
那些活动家们辩称岩壁依然岌岌可危。
地质系那个热心的初学者起草了初步的安全报告。
他的微型传感器太不显眼了，野生动物全都无视了它们。
沉重的钻井机器整整闲置了三个星期。
公司的采购部门拒绝购买更多炸药，直到他们能深入探究更新后的法规。
他们相信自己的法律团队是绝不会出错的。
最终，州委员会选择同意这些安全调查结果，下发了最后批文。
